name: Agora Bermuda Limited
summary: Bermuda-licensed issuer of AUSD and operator of Agora stablecoin infrastructure.
notes: Official terms identify Agora Bermuda Limited as issuer of AUSD.

name: BitGo
summary: Digital-asset trust, custody, and infrastructure group that issues USD1 and processes its initial purchases and redemptions.
notes: USD1 documentation distinguishes BitGo's issuer role from World Liberty Financial's brand and service roles.

name: World Liberty Financial
summary: Owner of the World Liberty Financial USD1 brand and provider of services related to USD1.
notes: Not recorded as the legal issuer of USD1; official documentation assigns issuance and direct redemption processing to BitGo.

name: Mountain Protocol
summary: Former issuer and current wind-down overseer of the rebasing USDM stablecoin.
notes: Phase 3 terms describe Mountain Protocol Limited as the former issuer and current overseer of the wind-down.

name: Quantoz Payments B.V.
summary: Dutch electronic-money institution supervised by De Nederlandsche Bank and issuer of USDQ and other regulated electronic-money tokens.
notes: USDQ is recorded as an electronic-money token under the Quantoz Payments issuer framework.
